import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Initialize the matplotlib figure

# Create a barplot
sns.barplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='hour_of_day', data=df, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title

plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Amount')

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Initialize the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a barplot
sns.barplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='hour_of_day', data=df, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Type and Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Amount')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png')
